findings.message: [BR-55]-Each Preceding Invoice reference (BG-3) shall contain a Preceding Invoice reference (BT-25).
[BR-KSA-F-06-C22]-Field character limits for Billing reference ID field (BT-25) have not been met. The minimum limit is 1 character and the maximum limit is 5000 characters.
[BR-KSA-17]-Debit and credit note (invoice type code (BT-3) is equal to 383 or 381) must contain the reason (KSA-10) for this invoice type issuing.
[BR-KSA-19]-Each Document level charge (BG-21) shall have a code for the reason for document level charge (BT-105).
[BR-KSA-56]-For credit notes ((BT-3) has the value of 381) and debit notes ((BT-3) has the value of 383), the billing reference ID (BT-25) is mandatory.
[BR-KSA-69]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) 'Zero rated' shall have a VAT exception reason code (BT-121).
